summary: News Corp filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose daily buyback transaction notices provided to the Australian Securities Exchange pursuant to its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program. The filing is a routine disclosure of ongoing repurchases of Class A and Class B common stock; it does not announce a new repurchase authorization or any special-situation event. No deal terms or specific transaction details are provided. This is a standard current report, not a special situation. What to watch: no action required; the repurchase program continues as previously authorized.
